task_description: Complete design overhaul of SmoothOpsX web app with premium liquid glass / glassmorphism aesthetic, 3D elements, and emerald/teal accent colors. All pages (landing, auth, dashboard, onboarding) get glass treatment while preserving all business logic.

verification.summary: npm run build passes cleanly (exit code 0). No test suite exists in this project - build success is the validation. Docker not applicable. All pages compile and bundle correctly. Two rounds of semantic review were conducted with all confirmed issues resolved.
